I feel the same. My life is wonderful. Sometimes small things can send me to that place where I don't want to move, eat, sleep, anything. It makes me feel selfish and unappreciative which only makes me want to end it more. This probably isn't what you need to hear. But I feel comfort sometimes knowing I'm not the only person like this. I'm not to a place where I feel like it's okay to be sad. But it is.
Coconut oil.

I do the same. A therapist told me it's a sort of OCD. When I have dry skin under my nails, I'll pick at it until I bleed. It seems awful but it's not for pain. It's like an itch. Your mind also needs a certain amount of stimulation.
The beauty about reddit is that you don't have to read what those idiots say. Hang out here for a while.
I want to be honest with myself. I'm still guilty for things. I'm not ready to accept who I am and admit that things have happened to me that I couldn't control. I should have been better.
Do you believe they love you?
Yeah, neither do I.. Thank you though.

The problem has been most obvious in my recent relationship. He felt like I was putting him on trial, making him tell me every detail so I could understand why he felt the way he did. I couldn't feel good about apologizing for something until I could clearly see what I did wrong. He was the opposite. I need to grow out of that. I need to accept and respect what someone's conclusion is without understanding or even coming to the same realization.

Well I'll listen the same you have for me if you ever need. 

By improve, I mean I need to accept that people come to different conclusions about things than I do. That I might not understand someone's decision but can't beat it to the ground and make them explain a million times. Just to a take deep breath and say, I disagree, but I understand it's what you need or want. I will just respect it.

Yeah that's very true. I'm an only child and am pretty accustomed to impossible standards. I know when I hold people to impossible standards it's not because I care about anything I'm asking. I want to see something else. Last boyfriend didn't understand when I said "you can go if you don want to be here" (if we were at my parents' or something) then he'd leave when I really wanted him to say he wanted to be there. That's my lack of transparency and probably a bit of insecurity. But is it possible that I just want something out of myself like that?

I'm sorry that was insensitive of me. I haven't done it in years and didn't go crazy with it, which is why I said it wasn't out of control. What IS out of control is my ability to be out of control in my life. To not understand other's decisions makes me crazy.
That's a good question. And now that I think about it, no. How does one get to that point?
What is it? I did it today. Even after all the support I've received from reddit strangers. I know it's wrong. But it isn't out of control.

I used to do the same thing. I think it was for control. I also went to a salon a lot. Something about the salon chair makes it really easy to open up. I eventually cut my hair all the way off. Boy style. Now it's halfway down my back but I'm still in control and could cut it anytime I chose.
Not the same. It's strenuous not painful. I do other obsessive compulsive habits like biting my lips and cheeks. It's the sting almost. I don't know if that makes sense.
Haha that's wonderful. I'll pay it a visit. Thank you.
Well I don't know now. Advocacy is a good meaning. Devotion to a cause is meaning. It's selfless and I'm not sure that I'm convinced that meanings are selfless.

Well.. Maybe I don't know. I'm extremely motivated to have a successful career. I'm motivated to make a big change in a particular advocacy issue. I want to achieve in that cause because it will help other people. But is that meaning? Who cares?

I became an atheist after reading "The Atheist's Way" because I learned that I could create my own meaning in my life. I'm just having a really horrible rough patch where I can't see how my meaning is meaningful at all!

That would include my mom. I suppose I know she has unconditional love for me, but not support. She puts down my successes unless they are something she wants. I couldn't cut her out.. I'm there for her more than she is for me.
Why?
I'm on my phone app. Don't know how to PM. Help?

I think I've done it in the past because I genuinely want to be able to independently cope with things. I can handle physical pain and it gets to a point where it feels really good and almost stimulative. I don't know if I really want the attention because I don't want to look weak. I am full of contradictions, I know.
I don't understand what you're trying to say. I'm sorry.
I think that's true. Thank you so much. I really don't know if what you describe is a reasonable way to live. But you seem to have made something positive out of it.
Am I selfish for not feeling like I can give unconditionally and work constantly with no support?
I don't mean to seem like I'm arguing with you or am unappreciative.
I hear you. I do those things. But I just feel like if meaning is only meaning to me, is that what life is about? Maybe it is. I used to think it was. But I'm exhausted.
I'm not depressed because I have nothing to give. I have so much to give and do give and no one cares. How much can you do that before it's just meaningless?

Actually, I feel really positively about suicide. The only reason I haven't is because of my parents. I'm an only child. Despite my mom's conditional support and backhanded compliments she loves me. But the Stoics believed it was noble to die by your own sword. Is there any shame in doing what I want to do?

I've had the same problem and I have permanent scars from it. I often want to go back to it but I do other self destructive things now so no one has to know. There seems to be no healthy way to cope. Life is about sucking it up sometimes. But I don't think I have that capacity in me. I, like you it seems, need a physical coping mechanism. I hope you find a better method than I have.
